Desc.SourceString: “接触和观察只是第一步，接下来做出改变就靠你了，引航者。”
Desc.LocalizedString: Making contact and observing are only the first steps. It's up to you to make the next move, Navigator.

Desc.SourceString: 世界之锚，城市的信标，闪耀弦能之光的高塔。
Desc.LocalizedString: The anchor of the world. The beacon of the city. A shining tower of string energy.

Desc.SourceString: 正负归零，而后湮灭。
Desc.LocalizedString: Both the positive and negative become zero, and then, annihilation.

Desc.SourceString: 追求之物，是未来、真相，以及抗争。
Desc.LocalizedString: We seek the future, truth, and resistance.

Desc.SourceString: 从那碎片中满溢而出的，是灵魂的颜色。
Desc.LocalizedString: Overflowing from the fragments is the color of the soul.

Desc.SourceString: 我所追求的自由，才不是那种虚无缥缈的东西！
Desc.LocalizedString: The freedom I pursue is far from being elusive!

Desc.SourceString: 天空中飞舞着无数灵感，难道你看不见它们吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: The sky is filled with inspiration. Can you not see?

Desc.SourceString: 我们都是扑火的飞蛾，明知会被这时代所燃成灰烬，却依旧义无反顾。
Desc.LocalizedString: We are all moths attracted to the fire of times. We know we will be burned to ashes, but we still proceed without hesitation.

Desc.SourceString: 我一定会保护所有人，一定。
Desc.LocalizedString: I will protect everyone. I have to.

Desc.SourceString: 只要世间不公尚在，我的抗争就不会停止。
Desc.LocalizedString: As long as there is injustice, I will not rest.

Desc.SourceString: 杀手只要执行任务就够了，不需要理由。
Desc.LocalizedString: An assassin needs no reason. Only the task matters.

Desc.SourceString: 愿星光照耀你的前路。
Desc.LocalizedString: May the starlight illuminate your path.

Desc.SourceString: 好啦好啦，别紧张嘛，车到山前必有路，不要担心那么多啦……
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, take it easy. We'll find a way when the time comes. Stop worrying...

Desc.SourceString: 剪破虚妄。这是我们最初的愿景，亦是最深的信仰。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cutting through illusions. This has always been our vision and deepest belief.

Desc.SourceString: 乌尔比诺，可以让你无限接近自由的答案。
Desc.LocalizedString: Urbino is the answer.

Desc.SourceString: 总有人要背负黑暗，我并不介意那人是我。
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone has to bear the darkness. I don't mind being that person.

Desc.SourceString: 我们可是搜查官诶？搜查官抓坏人，难道不是理所当然的事情吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Come on, we're investigators. It's our job to apprehend criminals.

Desc.SourceString:
欧泊之眼，芙拉薇娅，幸会。
要和我下一局棋吗？
Desc.LocalizedString:
Flavia, the Eye of P.U.S. A pleasure to meet you.
Care for a game of chess with me?

Desc.SourceString: 我是艾卡，因为一些原因要戴上这个面具，不过我还是会好好保护你的！
Desc.LocalizedString: The memories still linger in my mind.

Desc.SourceString: 如持有者的灵魂一般热枕。
Desc.LocalizedString: As fervent as the holder's soul.

Desc.SourceString: 我闻到了，你的气息。
Desc.LocalizedString: I smell blood.

Desc.SourceString: 愿你，永远被温柔以待。
Desc.LocalizedString: May you find happiness and love.

Desc.SourceString: 极速救援，使命必达。
Desc.LocalizedString: We will rescue you.

Desc.SourceString: 我们洞悉一切，而非监视一切。
Desc.LocalizedString: We know everything without monitoring.

Desc.SourceString: 我的梦想，在何处才能实现？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where can my dream be realized?

Desc.SourceString: 穿过假象，你将看到真实的我。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything you see is an illusion.

Desc.SourceString: 尝尝火力大喵的厉害吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Here comes Mighty Meowblast!

Desc.SourceString: 正义与守护。
Desc.LocalizedString: Justice and protection.

Desc.SourceString: 唯自由可贵。
Desc.LocalizedString: Liberty is the most precious of all.

Desc.SourceString: 守护，还是救赎？
Desc.LocalizedString: Protection or redemption?

Desc.SourceString: 88区，卡拉彼丘最庞大的金融系统坐落于此。
Desc.LocalizedString: Area 88 is where the largest financial system of Strinova is located.

Desc.SourceString: 武器的迭代从未停止，手握武器的人们，却早已停滞不前。
Desc.LocalizedString: Weapon development never stops, but those who wield them have long stagnated.

Desc.SourceString: 卡丘人是人类的进化方向……吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are Strinovians the future of humanity?

Desc.SourceString: 无限与永恒，或许只是一个可笑的悖论。
Desc.LocalizedString: Infinity and eternity may very well be a ridiculous paradox.

Desc.SourceString:
卡拉彼丘纪念日，一切开始的日子。
希望由此而生，悲剧亦由此而生。
Desc.LocalizedString:
It all started on Strinova Day.
It created hope but also tragedy.

Desc.SourceString: 这蓝色，代表冷静，还是残酷？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does the blue represent calmness or cruelty?

Desc.SourceString: 为了欧泊而战！
Desc.LocalizedString: For PUS!

Desc.SourceString: 为了剪刀手而战！
Desc.LocalizedString: For The Scissors!

Desc.SourceString: 在人类接触到弦能后，也就开启了新的时代。
Desc.LocalizedString: As humanity came into contact with superstrings, a new era began.

Desc.SourceString: 移民潮的到来，使卡丘变得繁荣。
Desc.LocalizedString: Immigrants brought prosperity to Strinova world.

Desc.SourceString: 轮回计划带来的泪水是希望还是绝望？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does Project Reincarnation bring tears of hope or despair?

Desc.SourceString: 剪刀手的第一颗火种点燃于真实荒野之中。
Desc.LocalizedString: The first spark of The Scissors was lit in the True Wilderness.

Desc.SourceString: 那一天，她才意识到，这一切本就如此荒谬。
Desc.LocalizedString: On that day, she realized that it had always been absurd.

Desc.SourceString: 迈入通道之后，他明白了，自己只是换了一副枷锁。
Desc.LocalizedString: As he stepped into the passage, he understood that he had put on another pair of shackles.

Desc.SourceString: 要我帮你冷静一下吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Should I help calm you down?

Desc.SourceString: 生命如歌，而我，为它谱写音符。
Desc.LocalizedString: Life is like a song, and I compose notes for it.

Desc.SourceString: 来听我的歌吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hear my song!

Desc.SourceString: 大家！看过来哦！香奈美正在闪闪发亮呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Look at me, everyone! I'm shining!

Desc.SourceString: 人类的末路，在这里，以最丑陋的姿态显现。
Desc.LocalizedString: The end of humanity is displayed here in its most unpleasant form.

Desc.SourceString: 即便遥不可及，我们依旧会仰望星空。
Desc.LocalizedString: We look up at the stars even if they are out of reach.

Desc.SourceString: 当它破碎，美梦不再。
Desc.LocalizedString: When it shatters, so does the dream.

Desc.SourceString: 埃利蒙德，卡丘世界的政治中枢，欧泊本部坐落于此。
Desc.LocalizedString: Elmond, where the PUS headquarters is located, is the political center of Strinova World.

Desc.SourceString: 几何线条勾勒的虚无荒野。
Desc.LocalizedString: A void wilderness outlined with geometric lines.

Desc.SourceString: 被舍弃的不纯污染物组成了它们。
Desc.LocalizedString: Formed by abandoned impure pollutants.

Desc.SourceString: 难以重返的香格里拉。
Desc.LocalizedString: A Shangri-La one cannot easily return to.

Desc.SourceString: 我们就像是在小小的纸船上的蝼蚁，风浪来临时，一朝倾覆。
Desc.LocalizedString: We are ants on a tiny boat made of paper overturned as the whitewater hits.

Desc.SourceString: 财富的积累，从规划蓝图就开始了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The accumulation of wealth begins with blueprints.

Desc.SourceString: 狭窄通道中的虚实博弈。
Desc.LocalizedString: A game of reality and illusion in a narrow passage.

Desc.SourceString: 开阔室外的火力倾泻。
Desc.LocalizedString: In this open outdoor space, intense gunfights ensues.

Desc.SourceString: 一切在我眼前消失……
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything disappears before me...

Desc.SourceString: 为了生存而进化的争斗者们。
Desc.LocalizedString: Warriors evolved for survival.

Desc.SourceString: 轮回，而后，以过去之名，开始新的人生。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reincarnate and start a new life in the name of the past.

Desc.SourceString: 在烈焰中起舞吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dance in the flames.

Desc.SourceString: 虚幻的晓光，遮蔽住盲目之人的双眼。
Desc.LocalizedString: The dawn of illusion obscures the eyes of the blind.

Desc.SourceString: 有时，她会沉浸在往事之中，难以自拔。
Desc.LocalizedString: She sometimes immerses herself in the past, unable to break free.

Desc.SourceString: 友人啊，为何分离如此匆匆。
Desc.LocalizedString: Why did we part so hastily, my friend?

Desc.SourceString: 星光啊，守护那些我所爱的人吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: May the stars protect those I love.

Desc.SourceString: 父亲，我不会让你失望的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I will not let you down, Father.

Desc.SourceString: 黎明之下亦有阴影。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are shadows beneath the dawn.

Desc.SourceString: 黄昏之刻亦有余晖。
Desc.LocalizedString: A ray of lingering light at dusk.

Desc.SourceString: 前路茫茫，前路何方？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where does the path lead?

Desc.SourceString: 唱响吧，小夜莺。唱响迎接黎明的欢歌。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sing, nightingale. Sing to the coming dawn.

Desc.SourceString: 我永远…会在这条荆棘路上前行。
Desc.LocalizedString: I will always... tread this treacherous path.

Desc.SourceString: 过往的荣光，由我重拾。
Desc.LocalizedString: I will reclaim the glories of the past.

Desc.SourceString: 终有一天，你们，会回来的……
Desc.LocalizedString: One day, you will return...

Desc.SourceString: 我的笔端蘸着的，不是颜料，是梦想哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't draw with paint, but dreams.

Desc.SourceString: 一切才刚刚开始。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything has just begun.

Desc.SourceString: 快乐的构成元素。
Desc.LocalizedString: An element of happiness.

Desc.SourceString: 一个人能想到的最坏结局。
Desc.LocalizedString: The worst ending imaginable.

Desc.SourceString: 弦能为人类带来了无限的可能性。
Desc.LocalizedString: Superstrings have brought infinite possibilities to humanity.

Desc.SourceString: 传递生命的模因。
Desc.LocalizedString: A model for transmitting life.

Desc.SourceString: 时间会见证一切选择。
Desc.LocalizedString: Time witnesses every choice.

Desc.SourceString: 在离散的时间之流中，极限即为无限。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the discrete flow of time, infinity is the limit.

Desc.SourceString: 被关在盒子里时，猫在想什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: What is a cat thinking when it is trapped in the box?

Desc.SourceString: 谁能通过，我说了算。
Desc.LocalizedString: I decide who gets to pass.

Desc.SourceString: 为了自由而战！
Desc.LocalizedString: For liberty!

Desc.SourceString: 错落的世界，就像是，变成了碎片。
Desc.LocalizedString: A fragmented world is not unlike pieces that have come apart.

Desc.SourceString: 正义，在此萌芽！
Desc.LocalizedString: Justice buds here!

Desc.SourceString: 点燃反叛的烽火。
Desc.LocalizedString: Igniting the fire of rebellion.

Desc.SourceString: 守卫过去的荣光。
Desc.LocalizedString: Guarding past glories.

Desc.SourceString: 纸箱堆成的小山中，寻访往日的回忆。
Desc.LocalizedString: Revisit memories in a pile of cardboard boxes.

Desc.SourceString: 不如，让我们来杯红茶吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Would you like a cup of tea?

Desc.SourceString: 2024年，向卡丘世界启航！
Desc.LocalizedString: In 2024, set sail for Strinova!

Desc.SourceString: 一切的欢喜与悲伤，从此刻拉开序幕。
Desc.LocalizedString: The start of all joys and sorrows.

Desc.SourceString: 赋予2023社区赛最强玩家的强者之证。
Desc.LocalizedString: A proof of strength awarded to the strongest player of the 2023 Community Competition.

Desc.SourceString: 赋予2023社区赛优秀玩家的璀璨之证。
Desc.LocalizedString: A proof of potential awarded to outstanding players of the 2023 Community Competition.

Desc.SourceString: 神奇的东方国度所传承的古老文化瑰宝，在卡丘之心依旧熠熠生辉。
Desc.LocalizedString: An ancient relic from the mystical kingdom of the East that shines brightly in the heart of Strinova.

Desc.SourceString: 自童年起，我们就有了统一的身份：游戏玩家！
Desc.LocalizedString: Since we were children, we've had a shared identity: gamers!

Desc.SourceString: 和我痛快对战吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fight me!

Desc.SourceString: 重启五分钟罢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Restarting will only take five minutes.

Desc.SourceString: 艺术在等着我呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Art awaits me!

Desc.SourceString: 很明显，来到雪原的它可高兴了！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's visibly thrilled to come to the snowfield!

Desc.SourceString: 休息，休息一下~
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's take a break.

Desc.SourceString: 来讲个温暖的故事吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tell me a heartwarming story.

Desc.SourceString: 在甜美的梦中，她又回到了无忧无虑的童年。
Desc.LocalizedString: In a sweet dream, she returns to her carefree childhood.

Desc.SourceString: 凡未锚定者，终将消散。
Desc.LocalizedString: Those who are not anchored are doomed to disappear.

Desc.SourceString: 复盘，是为了下一场胜利。
Desc.LocalizedString: We review fought battles to ensure the victory of the next one.

Desc.SourceString: 起点亦是终点。
Desc.LocalizedString: The starting point is also the endpoint.

Desc.SourceString: 是无法找到出口，还是本就未被困缚？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you struggling to find an exit, or were you never trapped at all?

Desc.SourceString: 雨水从地面流向天空，而我们行走在云层之上。
Desc.LocalizedString: Rain flows from the ground to the sky as we walk above the clouds.

Desc.SourceString: 和海岸相交的天际线，会是旅程的终点吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the horizon by the coastline the end of our journey?

Desc.SourceString: 传闻牵着手看过花火的人，会永远在一起哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: It is said that those who watch fireworks holding hands will be together forever.

Desc.SourceString: 野火燃烧不尽，玫瑰永不枯萎。
Desc.LocalizedString: The wildfire burns in eternity, and the roses never wither.

Desc.SourceString: 已发生的事实和未发生的预测，都是演算的结果。
Desc.LocalizedString: Past events and future predictions are all the results of calculations.

Desc.SourceString: 最终的目的地是充满希望的彼岸。
Desc.LocalizedString: The final destination is the shore of hope.

Desc.SourceString: 保证安全的最佳手段，就是让每颗子弹正中敌人的眉心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Headshots are the best way to ensure your safety.

Desc.SourceString: 在暗处，蝴蝶已经布下了看不见的陷阱。
Desc.LocalizedString: The butterflies have set hidden traps in the dark.

Desc.SourceString: 是最甜蜜的梦境，也是最美好的现实。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's the sweetest dream and the most beautiful reality.

Desc.SourceString: 独角兽家族的荣光，由少女来守护。
Desc.LocalizedString: The girl shall uphold the honor of the unicorns.

Desc.SourceString:
大喵，你要去哪里！
外面的世界……
那你等等我，我们一起去！
Desc.LocalizedString:
Where are you going, Mighty Meow?
Outside...
Then wait for me. Let's go together!

Desc.SourceString: 拉开这场盛大演出的帷幕，让过去的时光随着新一年期许的乐声离去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Start this grand performance and welcome the new year with the sound of music.

Desc.SourceString: 我只是笑一笑，没别的意思。
Desc.LocalizedString: It was just a smile.

Desc.SourceString: 这一拳可不是什么人都接的下的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Only a few can take this punch!

Desc.SourceString: 你就是我们要找的人！
Desc.LocalizedString: You're just the one we're looking for!

Desc.SourceString: 炙热的灵魂永不孤单。
Desc.LocalizedString: The burning soul is never alone.

Desc.SourceString: 身处深海，还能触及光明吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: In the depths of the ocean, will you reach the light?

Desc.SourceString: 前路险阻，我将破开迷雾前行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Despite the obstacles, I will pierce through the fog.

Desc.SourceString: 那片温暖的光，伴我度过了孤独的童年。
Desc.LocalizedString: The warm light accompanied me through my lonely childhood.

Desc.SourceString: “诶？好奇怪，明明是按照菜谱一步一步来的呀……！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Eh? It's so strange. You obviously followed the recipe step by step...!"

Desc.SourceString: 用餐就要专注于食物，眼睛可不会开小差的。
Desc.LocalizedString: When eating, you need to focus on the food and your eyes won't wander.

Desc.SourceString: 香薄荷、白兰花、茉莉茶、燕麦片、金枪鱼……咖啡杯虽小，却能“包罗万象”。
Desc.LocalizedString: Winter savory, white champaca, jasmine tea, oatmeal, tuna... The tiny coffee cup is large enough to contain everything.

Desc.SourceString: 该抓哪一只好呢？不论哪只都好可爱！
Desc.LocalizedString: Which should I grab? They're all so cute!

Desc.SourceString:
“欢迎光临故地餐馆，这份煎蛋您要几分熟啊？”
最近在故地餐馆，这样的保留节目似乎颇有人气。
Desc.LocalizedString:
“Welcome to The Hometown. How would you like your egg cooked?”
Shows like this seem to be quite popular at the restaurant called The Hometown.

Name.LocalizedString: Philosophical Thought: Brain in a Vat

Desc.SourceString: 你如何担保自己不是活在这样的困境中？
Desc.LocalizedString: How can you be sure your life is not in such a predicament?

Desc.SourceString: 如果“他们”真的存在，我们应该早就发现“他们”了。
Desc.LocalizedString: If “they” were real, we would have discovered “them” by now.

Desc.SourceString:
“喵！喵喵喵！！”
喵喵卫士似乎正在训导不擅长游戏的火力大喵。
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Meow! Meow, meow, meow!"
Pawtector seems to be training Mighty Meow, who is not so good at video games.

Desc.SourceString: 虽不擅长游泳，但我不介意淹溺在冰块与糖分之中。
Desc.LocalizedString: Although I'm not good at swimming, I don't mind drowning in ice and sugar.

Desc.SourceString: 夜深人静之时，它还在不知疲惫地工作，工作……直到坏掉。
Desc.LocalizedString: It works tirelessly into the night... until it breaks down.

Desc.SourceString: 这里简直是饮料王国和艺术宝库！好想……好想全都买回家啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: A kingdom of drinks and a treasure trove of art! I want to... I want to buy everything!

Name.LocalizedString: A Day in the Life of a Shark

Desc.SourceString:
早起和人对打，中午吃鲷鱼烧，下午看武打片，晚上准时睡觉。
没有工作的一天，完美！
Desc.LocalizedString:
Wake up early and spar, have taiyaki for lunch, watch martial arts movies in the afternoon, and go to bed on time at night.
A perfect day without work!

Desc.SourceString: 承受暂时的束缚，是为了更长远的自由。
Desc.LocalizedString: To endure temporary constraints is to achieve long-term freedom.

Desc.SourceString: 这是伊薇特新学会的技能——制作刨冰哦。当然，也少不了菲的帮忙……
Desc.LocalizedString: I recently learned how to make shaved ice. Of course, Fay helped me a lot...

Desc.SourceString: 今天的卡丘世界，也是平和又安宁呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Another peaceful day in Strinova!

Desc.SourceString: 嘘，这是我和你的私人行程，不要被其他人找到哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sh, this is our trip. Don't let others find out.

Desc.SourceString: 曾伴随独角兽长大的琴音，也会响彻她的加冕之路。
Desc.LocalizedString: The melody that accompanied the unicorn's childhood shall sound again on the journey toward coronation.

Desc.SourceString: 并肩坐在竹影之下，灯光摇曳，一如心弦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sitting side by side under the shadows cast by bamboo. The lights flicker with the heartstrings.

Desc.SourceString: 纯白梦乡的入口在此，欢迎踩着云朵前来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Surf the clouds to arrive at the entrance of the pure dreamland!

Desc.SourceString: 重构，但并非以原本的顺序。那么，我还是我吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: If I were reconstructed differently, will I still be who I am?

Desc.SourceString: 多幸运，在万千星辰中被你发现。
Desc.LocalizedString: How lucky I am to be discovered by you among thousands of stars.

Desc.SourceString: 浮游在海中的水母，是否也会发出风铃的吟唱。
Desc.LocalizedString: Do jellyfish floating in the sea sing like wind chimes?

Desc.SourceString: 成功出道对我来说只是追梦的起点，香奈美会让整座城市都听见美妙的歌声。
Desc.LocalizedString: A successful debut is only the start of my journey. The entire city will hear my beautiful voice.

Desc.SourceString: 一切的一切，只不过是镜花水月。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything is an illusion.

Desc.SourceString: 蝴蝶的一生有四个时期，人们将卡丘世界中那多出一蜕称为“永恒”。
Desc.LocalizedString: A butterfly's life consists of four stages. The extra stage of metamorphosis in Strinova is known as eternity.

Desc.SourceString: 在一切皆由绘制而成的新世界，剪刀手仍倾心于那些传统手艺。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the new world where everything is drawn, The Scissors still favor traditional crafts.

Desc.SourceString: 电流，海浪，音浪的协同，将掀起新的风暴。
Desc.LocalizedString: Currents, waves, and sound are in synergy, stirring up a new storm.

Desc.SourceString: 将那些不同调的人轰个粉碎吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Eliminate the opposition!

Desc.SourceString: 让那些不协调的声音统统闭嘴！
Desc.LocalizedString: Silence the discordant voices!

Desc.SourceString: 把那些不够格的人列为猎物！
Desc.LocalizedString: The unqualified are prey!

Desc.SourceString: 【水箱中的鲨鱼，并不知道自己已经失去了自由，也不会因此感觉到痛苦。别人因此怜悯它失去了狩猎者的尊严，可鲨鱼，并不在乎。】
Desc.LocalizedString: 【The shark in the tank does not realize its freedom is lost, nor does it feel any pain. People pity it for losing the dignity of a predator, but the shark does not care.】

Desc.SourceString: 这香味，这是来自群芳的祝福……
Desc.LocalizedString: The fragrance is a blessing from the flowers...

Desc.SourceString: “那时我们拥有一切：年轻，勇敢，未开拓的世界，以及以为永不磨灭的希望。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “Youth, courage, a world to explore. We had everything, our hope undying.”

Desc.SourceString: “古老的神殿寂静无声，却又有着先行者与后来人的脚步在回响。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “Silent is the ancient temple, yet the footsteps of pioneers and successors echo throughout.”

Desc.SourceString: “即使异形已落入恒常的凋零，她仍将腐败的灵魂挽入花海。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “As her deformed body falls into eternal decay, she draws the corrupted souls into the sea of flowers nevertheless.”

Desc.SourceString: “如你寻见，请你静听：被封闭的不是疯狂的欲念，而是颤栗的心。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “If you find it, please listen carefully. What's sealed is not a mad desire but a trembling heart.”

Desc.SourceString: “她，或者是它，伫立在高塔彼端，带来无尽的恐惧和迷惘。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “She... It stands on top of the tower, bringing down endless fear and confusion.”

Desc.SourceString: “香并非只是味道，它意味着标志，故事，记忆，是生命与灵魂蕴结出的气息。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “Fragrance is more than just a scent. It signifies a symbol, a story, a memory, the formation of life and soul.”

Desc.SourceString: “人们不仅仅需要生存必须的庇护和资源，也需要叫醒灵魂的钟声与阳光。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “People need shelter and resources to survive, but also the bells and sunlight to awaken the soul.”

Desc.SourceString: “要问为什么，我也不知道，毕竟我只是一只火力大喵。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “Why? I don't know. I'm just a Mighty Meow.”

Desc.SourceString: “我们曾有过最美好的初衷，但通天之塔，终究朝向了不同的两端。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “We had the purest intentions, but the tower eventually led to opposite ends.”

Desc.SourceString: “熊仔会庇佑着你，当然主要是你脚下的土地。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “The bear will protect you, though mainly the land beneath you.”

Desc.SourceString: “先驱说，那来自弦能深处的光辉，像一场日出，为人类带来久别的华彩。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "The pioneers say the brilliance from the depths of string energy resembles sunrise, bringing long-lost splendor to humanity."

Desc.SourceString: “这里其实很美，所以当忙碌与纷扰结束，我们就去寻找彩虹吧。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “It's a beautiful place. Once everything settles down, let's look for rainbows.”

Desc.SourceString: 游戏开始，游戏结束。
Desc.LocalizedString: Game start. Game over.

Desc.SourceString: 雨滴深入地面，绽为纯白的花朵，你说你需要一个指引者，让我领你前往紫雨中吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Raindrops sink into the ground, blooming into pure white flowers. You said you need a guide; let me lead you into the violet rain.

Desc.SourceString:
【瑰丽的宫廷剑士向着远方眺望。
战场哭嚎，血涂四方。
装饰蔷薇的利剑刺穿了敌人的心脏。
蔷薇染血，逆影怒放。
思念如风，飘向远方。
“花期为君，死又何妨？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
The royal swordswoman, enchanting as a rose, gazes into the distance.
She sees nothing but carnage and rivers of blood.
The rose-decorated sword pierces an enemy's heart.
The rose is dyed in blood's hue; shadows cast wide their pall.
Her mind, like the breeze, wanders far, unconfined by any wall.
“For you alone, the flowers unveil their bloom; should they fade, what sorrow calls?”

Desc.SourceString:
【成为一线搜查官的米雪儿继承了上一代的意志，当一个警号重启的时候，那些可悲的罪犯应当颤抖，因为继承白虎意志的人，会将他们全部击溃，一个不留。
“里面的人给我听好了，你们已经被我一个人包围了！速速投降！”——米雪儿在行动中如此威吓着。
后来，她确实做到了这一点，仅凭一人将十余名犯罪分子尽数逮捕。
“我还以为看不到明天的太阳了，那小妮子是要吃人吗？”——犯罪分子筛糠一样颤抖地回忆着。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Having become a frontline investigator, Michele carries with her the will of her father. When a badge number is reactivated, the pitiful criminals better tremble in fear, for the successor of the White Tiger will defeat every single one of them.

“Listen up! I have you surrounded! Surrender now!” Michele once intimidated suspects like this during operations.
And she kept her word, singlehandedly arresting over a dozen suspects.
"I thought I wouldn't see the light of day again. Was she going to devour us like a wild tiger?" a criminal recalls, trembling in fear.

Desc.SourceString: 每个人的心中，都有一片海洋。
Desc.LocalizedString: There is an ocean in everyone's heart.

Desc.SourceString: 今日，我们纵情欢歌！明日，我们并肩战斗！
Desc.LocalizedString: Today, we sing! Tomorrow, we fight as one!

Desc.SourceString: 我是……独一无二的熊猫伊薇特。
Desc.LocalizedString: I am... the one and only Panda Yvette.

Desc.SourceString: 想看就看个够吧！不、不过新品的咖啡，还是得务必品尝一下……哦？
Desc.LocalizedString: Go ahead, take a good look! B-But make sure to try our new coffee... please?

Desc.SourceString: 香奈美是属于大家的偶像，但是……此时此刻，请让我成为专属于您的女仆。
Desc.LocalizedString: Kanami is everyone's idol, but... for now, let me provide you with an exclusive maid café experience.

Desc.SourceString: 客人，这样的话，菲也会很困扰的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Fay wouldn't know what to make of this either, sir...

Desc.SourceString: 今日会降下一些……不一样的雨。
Desc.LocalizedString: Today, there will be... a different kind of rain.

Desc.SourceString: 纵使时间流逝，反抗的意志永不湮灭！
Desc.LocalizedString: With each passing moment, the resolve to resist only grows stronger!

Desc.SourceString: 古早的桌面娱乐，当然难不住现代的超级玩家！
Desc.LocalizedString: Classic board games are a piece of cake for the modern super player!

Desc.SourceString: 鹤阵已成，故人何在？
Desc.LocalizedString: The crane formation stands ready, but where lingers the friend once known?

Desc.SourceString: 天高云阔处，独行且放歌。
Desc.LocalizedString: In the endless expanse of the sky, I wander solo, my song soaring freely.

Desc.SourceString: 让心害羞跳动的，是与你共度的每个瞬间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Every moment in your company makes my heart race.

Desc.SourceString: 有熊出没，请勿惊慌，它会在补充完糖分后自行离开。
Desc.LocalizedString: A bear has been sighted. Do not panic; it will leave on its own after replenishing sugar.

Desc.SourceString: 守护大家的甜蜜梦想，也是搜查官责任的一部分！
Desc.LocalizedString: It is the investigator's duty to protect everyone's sweet dreams!

Desc.SourceString: 请问要喝点什么？不，熊只是长得凶，没有不高兴，这位客人，别走啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Would you like something to drink? Don't worry, the bear just looks like that. It's not upset. Wait! Please don't go!

Desc.SourceString: 宇航员心夏，出舱感觉良好！
Desc.LocalizedString: Astronaut Kokona is feeling well out of the cabin!

Desc.SourceString: 绘梦的兔子会梦见什么呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What does a dream-painting rabbit dream of?

Desc.SourceString: 遨游太空，漫步苍穹。
Desc.LocalizedString: Voyaging across the cosmos, wandering through the celestial expanse.

Desc.SourceString: 让我看看，这脚印是去往哪里？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where do these footprints lead?

Desc.SourceString: 挑战永远在她的脚下。
Desc.LocalizedString: There is no challenge too difficult for her.

Desc.SourceString: 胜利，然后继续胜利。
Desc.LocalizedString: Win, and keep winning.

Desc.SourceString: 精灵，就在你的身边。
Desc.LocalizedString: The spirit is with you.

Desc.SourceString: 总会有美味与你分享。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are always delicacies to share with you.

Desc.SourceString: 你在讲一个很老又很新的故事？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you telling a story that is both old and new?

Desc.SourceString: 她好像更加喜欢肉食。
Desc.LocalizedString: She seems to prefer meat.

Desc.SourceString: 思乡的乐曲，静静奏响。
Desc.LocalizedString: A nostalgic song is quietly played.

Desc.SourceString: 自由的声音，已然奏响。
Desc.LocalizedString: The sound of liberty echoes.

Desc.SourceString: 我想表现出最好的一面。
Desc.LocalizedString: I want to show my best side.

Desc.SourceString: 最美的梦，就是和你在一起。
Desc.LocalizedString: The sweetest dream is one with you in it.

Desc.SourceString: 玩音乐超开心的！
Desc.LocalizedString: I love playing music!

Desc.SourceString: 我将践行一切荣耀。
Desc.LocalizedString: I shall uphold honor.

Desc.SourceString: “为什么穿这么红？当然是因为红色能带来好运啦！和我靠得越近，好运也会降临你身边哦！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Why do I wear red? Because it brings good luck! The closer you are to me, the luckier you will be!"

Desc.SourceString: 凭栏观望远，飒沓如辰星。
Desc.LocalizedString: Resting on the balustrade, gazing afar, shining like a morning star.

Desc.SourceString: 悬灯结彩处，夜游寄相思。
Desc.LocalizedString: Amidst lanterns aglow and vibrant festoons, my yearning takes a nocturnal promenade.

Desc.SourceString: 金玲报春讯，乘风喜事迎。
Desc.LocalizedString: Golden chimes announce the dawn of spring, carrying joy on the breeze.

Desc.SourceString: 沐春良宵至，佳人共此时。
Desc.LocalizedString: We bask in the splendid spring night, cherishing this instant in unity.

Desc.SourceString: 孤寂寒夜风雪潇潇，营帐外，沉寂已久的梅花竟在深雪中露出点点殷红。
Desc.LocalizedString: On a cold night of wind and now, outside the tent, the long-withered plum blossoms reveal a touch of bright red amidst the deep snow.

Desc.SourceString: 客人，关于你的事情，我可以近距离观察记录么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Guest, can I observe and record your affairs from a close distance?

Desc.SourceString: 想要换取情报么，客人？呵呵，先赢了我再说喔~
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you want to exchange information, guest? Haha, let me win first and then talk~

Desc.SourceString: 如果不想被列入需要分类清除的名单……那么，别碍事。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you don't want to be put on a list that needs to be sorted out... well, stay out of the way.

Desc.SourceString: 欢迎光临回味时光咖啡厅~您希望与谁度过一段美丽的时光呢，客人？
Desc.LocalizedString: Welcome to Café Reminiscence! Who would you like to spend a lovely time with?

Desc.SourceString: 店内出现了身份不明的人……客人，为了你的安全，必要的时候我会采取行动。
Desc.LocalizedString: An unidentified person appears in the store...Guest, for your safety, I will take action when necessary.

Desc.SourceString:
第一次，她不用躲在隐蔽处，真正地可以与活生生的鲨鱼见面。这是她一直以来的心愿。
在如梦似幻的海底，鲨鱼丝毫不排斥她，始终萦绕着她……
Desc.LocalizedString: For the first time, she didn't have to hide in a secluded spot and could actually meet a live shark. This has been her long-cherished wish. In the dreamy seabed, the shark did not reject her at all, and always lingered around her...

Desc.SourceString: 取名自“苍雷潜龙”本人的名号，以游龙与苍雷为主题的英雄战袍。这身衣袍同它的主人一同行走八方、纵横四海，在无数侠客故事中为人津津乐道。
Desc.LocalizedString: Named after the ancient thunderous Loong from the East, this heroic attire features dragon and lightning motifs. It travels with its master across lands and seas, becoming a legendary tale among adventurers.

Desc.SourceString: 终点虽然重要，但也不要忽视沿途的美丽风景
Desc.LocalizedString: The destination is important, but do not overlook the beautiful scenery along the way.

Desc.SourceString:
传闻在蜂鸟大道53号，有一家名为“禁猎之地”的酒吧。这里供应各式美酒佳酿，乐曲悠扬，灯影摇晃。不少拜访者说这里宛若天堂般美好，而其他人却说这里并不开放。
【“走入夜色的方法，你找得到吗？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
“It is rumored that there is a bar called The Sanctuary at 53 Hummingbird Avenue. The establishment serves all kinds of fine wines while soothing music is played and lights flicker. Some visitors compare it with paradise, while others say it is not open to the public.”
【“Can you find the way to enter the night?”】

Desc.SourceString: 歌声越是轻而柔和，越能长久延续。就如锻刀可以斩断无数坚硬的事物，却无法斩断流水。
Desc.LocalizedString: The softer and gentler a song, the longer it lasts. A forged blade may cut through the toughest armor but cannot sever the flowing water.

Desc.SourceString:
虽然单杯酒的度数不高，但如果喝太多杯的话，还是会醉的。
你看着我也没用，这真·的·是最后一杯了。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Even though this liquor is not particularly strong, drinking too much gets you drunk nonetheless.
Staring at me won't help. It's really my last one for the night.

Desc.SourceString:
你很好奇，我在观察什么？
很多种可能哦。这副牌，这场局，还有——你。
Desc.LocalizedString:
What am I observing?
There are countless possibilities. The cards, the game, and you.

Desc.SourceString: 在静谧的夜空之下独自起舞，我寻找的舞伴，会是你吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Dancing by myself at night. Could you be the partner I am searching for?

Desc.SourceString: 想与你共度一段难忘的旅途，在萤光点点的大海中。
Desc.LocalizedString: I wish to embark on an unforgettable journey with you, in a sea filled with glowing lights.

Desc.SourceString: 在翻涌的浪潮之中，火花只会燃烧得愈发炽热！
Desc.LocalizedString: In the surging waves, the sparks burn only brighter!

Desc.SourceString: 海洋的怀抱竟是如此温暖而宽广，让我也可以遨游其间。
Desc.LocalizedString: The ocean's embrace is warm and vast, letting me freely wander within it.

Desc.SourceString: 蝴蝶的影子不止在春日翩然。
Desc.LocalizedString: The butterfly's shadow dances not only in spring.

Desc.SourceString: 声音也是欺诈的手段之一。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sound is one of the means of deception.

Desc.SourceString: 并不是所有的猫都害怕水。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not all cats fear water.

Desc.SourceString: 我们将结下新的友谊。
Desc.LocalizedString: We will form new friendships.

Desc.SourceString: 她去过这片大地的每一个角落，从今往后，她将涉足天空。
Desc.LocalizedString: She has traversed every corner of this land, and from now on, she will tread the skies.

Desc.SourceString: 行走于真实和虚幻之间，穿梭在弦音和虚无边缘。
Desc.LocalizedString: Roam through the realms of reality and dream, dancing on the seams of harmony and void.

Desc.SourceString: 在这样安静而舒适的环境中休养，伤病一定能更快被治愈吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Resting in such a quiet and comfortable environment will surely help heal wounds.

Desc.SourceString: “这可不是嘴馋，不吃饱哪有力气打架？”
Desc.LocalizedString: “I haven't got the munchies. I need a full belly before I can fight!”

Desc.SourceString: “如有招待不周，还请多多包涵。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “Please let us know if anything is not to your liking.”

Desc.SourceString: “就为这上好的新茶，我也愿意常来拜访哦。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “I'll come visit often, if only for the amazing tea.”

Desc.SourceString: 我们将创造这个世界上的一切。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll shape all that exists in this world.

Desc.SourceString: 书里描述的阳光，到底是什么样的温度呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder how warm is the sunlight described in the books.

Desc.SourceString: 从心底生长出来的旋律，化作了一首名为永恒与希望的歌。
Desc.LocalizedString: A melody born from the heart transforms into a song of eternity and hope.

Desc.SourceString: “你们……没注意到客人脸上露出了为难的表情吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Surely you saw the troubled expression on the guest's face?"

Desc.SourceString: “这种古老的技艺传承，是杀死过去的方法，是拯救未来的手段。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "This ancient craft is a way to kill the past and save the future."

Desc.SourceString:
千面之月凌空升起，月光女神俯瞰大地。
你抬头注视月亮时，月亮也正注视着你。
Desc.LocalizedString:
The moon of a thousand faces ascends, and the Moon Goddess watches over all.
As you look upon her brilliance, know that she gazes back with equal wonder.

Desc.SourceString: 探索世界的危险不仅来自无法确定的未来，也来自被封存隔绝的过去。
Desc.LocalizedString: Threats in this world emerge from both an unknown future and an isolated past.

Desc.SourceString: 如果意识能被重置，是不是意味着所有的美好都会被一键退出？
Desc.LocalizedString: If consciousness could reset, would all joys vanish with a single click?

Desc.SourceString: “萌萌香香的蛋包饭！”
Desc.LocalizedString: Delightfully cute and tasty omelette rice!

Desc.SourceString: 据说过去的设计里，触摸心就会听到爱的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's said that past designs let you hear love when you touched its heart.

Desc.SourceString: “新的一年，祝大家福旺财旺运势旺……等等，瑞兽当然是指我肩膀上这只啊！不然呢？”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Wishing everyone a bountiful year of wealth and prosperity... Wait, the lucky beast? It's this little one on my shoulder, of course!"

Desc.SourceString: “被我的舞姿吸引？理所当然嘛。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Captivated by my performance? That's only natural."

Desc.SourceString: “如果你想的话，我会穿越时空来见你的哦。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "If you wish, I'd cross time and space to meet you."

Desc.SourceString: 重装形态艾卡，堂堂登场！
Desc.LocalizedString: Meet Eika in her bold new armor!

Desc.SourceString: 穿梭在科摩斯塔中的人，选择的是一条没有回头的路。他们唯有奋不顾身地奔向下一个黎明，才有可能迎来晨曦的第一缕光线。
Desc.LocalizedString: Those who enter Komos Tower choose a path with no return. Only by racing toward the next dawn can they catch the first light of a new day.

Desc.SourceString: “以学生会的名义通知你，这些都是禁止在学校做的事项。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "In the name of the student council, these activities are forbidden at school."

Desc.SourceString: “别急着要签名，把激动的呐喊留到我上台的时候吧！”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Hold those screams—let them loose when I hit the stage!"

Desc.SourceString: “校园生活的每一季都有专属收集品，比如此刻的樱花。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Every season at school has its treasures, like the cherry blossoms now."

Desc.SourceString: “希望老师不会发现，我正试图在教室里徒手制造大玩具。”
Desc.LocalizedString: Hope the teacher doesn't catch me trying to build a mega toy in class!

Desc.SourceString: “等会儿就从这里直接回家……不行，会因为危险行为被会长骂。”
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe I'll just head straight home from here... Wait, no... I'll get in trouble for that....

Desc.SourceString: “永夜古堡已经沉睡太久，是时候苏醒了。或许，你会出现在这场新生的盛宴上吗？”
Desc.LocalizedString: “Too long has the Castle of Eternal Night slumbered. It is time to awaken it. Will you take part in the grand revival?”

Desc.SourceString: “请别害怕，虽然常以黑布遮盖眼眸，但我并非无法视物。我只是不想亲眼看到更多的苦难……”
Desc.LocalizedString: "There's no need to be afraid. Though I often have my eyes covered, I am not blind. I simply choose not to witness more suffering..."

Desc.SourceString: “在成为女爵之前，他们用‘死神’来称呼我。那个女人真是捉摸不透啊，但正因如此，我才能分得一张邀请函。”
Desc.LocalizedString: “They called me the Grim Reaper before I became a countess. She is ever so unpredictable. Nonetheless, this is how I received an invitation.”

Desc.SourceString: “你在恐惧什么？战斗，离别，还是颠覆这一切的我？”
Desc.LocalizedString: What are you afraid of? Battle, farewell, or me turning it all upside down?

Desc.SourceString: 见我伊始，汝之生命已如风中残烛。
Desc.LocalizedString: From our first meeting, your life is like a candle in the wind.

Desc.SourceString: 火种的微光蒙蔽了判断，过久的警惕化作了敌视、背叛和中伤。
Desc.LocalizedString: Caution fades, leading to mistrust and betrayal.

Desc.SourceString: 树身雕刻着古老的印记，是探索者走向世界彼方的决心。
Desc.LocalizedString: The carvings on the tree reflect explorers' resolve to venture beyond.

Desc.SourceString: 人类沉溺于能量的潮水中，却依然追逐着生命才会诞生的剧痛。
Desc.LocalizedString: Engulfed by the surge of energy, humankind still pursues the pain that brings life.

Desc.SourceString: 它泛着金光，自远古而来，出现在每一个孩童的梦里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Glowing with a golden light, it comes from ancient times, appearing in every child's dream.

Desc.LocalizedString: Away from the chaos, finding peace in the countryside may just be the perfect therapy to share at Astral Sanctuary.

Desc.LocalizedString: A ticket for endless enjoyment! Experience the pastoral beauty at the enchanted ranch!

Desc.SourceString: 道馆的寻常一角，却因她成为一处风景。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just a regular dojo corner, made special by her presence.

Desc.SourceString: 明天，会是个风和日丽的好天气吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Will tomorrow be a beautiful day with clear skies?

Desc.SourceString: “想与您静赏，此刻的至美缭乱。”
Desc.LocalizedString: "Let's cherish this chaotic splendor together."

Desc.LocalizedString: Powerful, but mind the volume when in use!

Desc.SourceString: 感受吧，这色香味俱全的魅力！
Desc.LocalizedString: Savor the charm of its irresistible taste and scent!

Desc.SourceString:
【作为超级玩家的米雪儿拥有诸多休闲帅气的衣服，但作为一个撸猫客，她最喜欢的还是这一套萌喵风格的穿搭，不光是因为理想的舒适度或是贴近猫咪的可爱配色。

“猫露出肚皮是安全和友好的证明。”少女笑嘻嘻地说道。

卸下了玩家的酷炫，换上一身元气活泼的少女装扮，是否意味着，这个猫一般的女孩在传达着什么呢？】
Desc.LocalizedString:
Super gamer Michele has many stylish casual outfits. Of course, our cat lover prefers this cute cat-themed outfit, whether for its comfiness or the adorable kitty colors.

"Cats show their belly when they want to be friendly and feeling safe." The girl says, smiling.

Michele has changed her flashy gamer gear into a cute girl's outfit. Is the cat girl trying to tell you something with that change?

Desc.SourceString:
【"前辈有好好注视过这片星空吗？”
“据说，每个人都有一颗属于自己的星辰，它在宇宙里孤独地等待着，希望有一个人能与它遥遥相望。”
“如果有一天，前辈遥望天际的时候发现了一抹别样的光芒，那大概就是前辈的星辰正在眨眼吧。”
“前辈问我的星辰在哪里？那……那是秘密。”

少女从未曾停止对夜空的追寻。
在无数个与星光对视的夜晚里，少女等待着那颗星星，自浩瀚渺茫的星海里捕捉属于自己的光芒。
有一天，星星眨眼了。
整片夜空都改变了颜色。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Have you ever truly looked at the starry sky?"
"I heard there is a unique star for everyone, waiting alone in the universe, hoping someone would gaze at it."
"If one day you see an unusual light in the sky, that's probably your star winking at you."
"Where is my star? Well... that's a secret."

The girl never stops chasing the night sky.
Through countless nights under the stars, she patiently waits for that one star in the vast galaxy to reveal itself.
One day, the star winks at her.
And the entire night sky changes its colors.

Desc.SourceString:
【一支小提琴曲结束，奥黛丽坐到了你的身边。
“怎么，在我面前，还摆出一副闷闷不乐的样子。”
“你在担忧什么？是我们眼前面对的考验，还是必将到来的崩溃？”

她从茶壶里斟出了两杯红茶，将一杯放在了你的面前。
“抛下那些烦恼吧，让我们敬一杯苦难，再敬一杯……这个世界。”
茶杯轻触，发出清脆的声响。少女的唇角，绽放出一抹自信的笑容。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
【After playing a violin piece, Audrey sits next to you.
“Why do you still look so gloomy when I'm with you?”
“What are you worried about? The test we have to face? Or the inevitable collapse?”

She pours two cups of black tea and places one before of you.
“Let go of all the troubles. Let us toast to hardship and... this world.”
As the cups touch, producing a crisp sound,  the girl smiles confidently.】

Desc.SourceString:
【“你问这是什么？兰花。”
清雅的花草香气，从拉薇与你面前的茶盏中飘出。
洁白的花瓣，在茶水内舒展开来。
你注意到，在她的衣衫上，也绣有同样的花朵。

“这种花，只在春天开放。而在这个世界的春天，实在太过短暂。”
饮了口茶，眼前的少女露出了难以察觉的淡淡微笑。
对她来说，这段抛下一切事务与责任，短暂的休憩时光，就是属于她的春天。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
【“What flower is this? It's an orchid.”
The floral fragrance of the tea wafts from the cups in front of Lawine and you.
The pale petals unfold in your cup of tea.
You notice that a similar flower is embroidered on her clothes.

“Orchids only bloom in spring, a season far too short in this world.”
As she sips some tea, the girl in front of you smiles, barely perceptible.
For her, this brief respite from all her responsibilities and duties is her spring.】

Desc.SourceString:
【“不管是外出冒险也好，睡大觉也好，难得的休息日当然要做自己最喜欢的事！”。
结束了一天的忙碌，心夏换上舒适的居家服，慵懒地躺在家中。

身边是成堆的纸箱，和五花八门的道具。
其中既有来不及整理的过往回忆，也有前往新的未知天地的必备工具。
“哎呀，你也别光看着了，快来给我出点主意。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
【“Whether it's going on an adventure or simply sleeping in, one must do what they love the most on a rare off day!”
Having finished a day's work, Kokona changes into comfortable clothes and lays down.

Next to her are stacks of boxes and all kinds of items.
Among them are memorabilia she has not had time to organize and essential tools for her future explorations.
“Come on. Don't just stand there. Help me out.”】

Desc.SourceString:
【“今天要帮星庇所设计儿童绘本，明天答应了要给领居家的阿姨做室内客厅……”
又真是无比充实的一天，她总是以帮助别人为乐。只是这一次，你注意到了她脸上些许的疲惫。

“等等，顾问，别动——！”
 “对，就是这个姿势，就是这个眼神！”
少女发出惊叹，就像寻到了世上仅有的至宝。
“既然是休息日……顾问，可以请你做我的模特吗？”
少女走近了她最信任的人的身侧，散发着独属于她的温暖气息，眼睛里满是你的身影。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Today, I have to design a children's book for Astral Sanctuary. As for tomorrow, I promised my neighbor I'd help her design her living room..."
It is another incredibly fulfilling day for the girl who finds joy in helping others. But this time, you notice a hint of weariness in her expression.

"Hold on, Navigator. Don't move!"
"That's it! That's the look!"
The girl exclaims as if she has found the world's rarest treasure.
"Since it's your day off... Navigator, would you model for me?"
The girl approaches the person she trusts the most, sharing her unique warmth, her eyes filled with you and only you.

Desc.SourceString:
【“也不是真的，不喜欢出门……”
女孩不好意思地把小熊兜帽的帽檐往下扯了扯：“只是外面人太多了，很吵闹……家里，有菲，有毛绒毯子，还有喝不完的冰饮料……”
“伊薇特觉得，呆在家里也很开心……你，你会同意我的看法吧？”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
“It's not that I don't like going out...”
The girl shyly pulls down the brim of her bear hoodie. “It's just that there are too many people outside, and it's noisy... At home, I have Fay, blankets, and endless chilled drinks...”
“I think it's really nice to just stay at home... W-Wouldn't you agree?”

Desc.SourceString:
【作为偶像的香奈美平时很喜欢研究妆容造型。
无论是清透的白开水裸妆，还是精致的舞台亮片妆，香奈美都能很好地完成。任何彩妆产品一旦到了她的手里，就能被巧妙地运用起来。
此时此刻，做好妆造的香奈美用唇膏在镜子上画了一个可爱的标记。
“引航者，你会不会染上香奈美的颜色呢？”。】
Desc.LocalizedString:
【As an idol, Kanami enjoys spending time on makeup and styles.
Whether it's a natural look or an elegant stage look, Kanami excels at putting them on, skillfully applying any makeup products.
As Kanami finishes her makeup, she draws a cute mark on the mirror with her lipstick.
“Navigator, will you be colored by my hues?”】

Desc.SourceString:
【“你要再来一块鲷鱼烧吗？或者甜甜鲨？”
坐在地垫上的绯莎向我伸出两只手，左手是一块鲷鱼烧，右手是一根甜甜鲨，左右都是甜蜜的烦恼。
虽然确实很好吃，但今天的糖分摄入实在太多了，我咽了咽口水，坚定拒绝了绯莎。
“不吃算了。”绯莎耸耸肩，啊呜一口咬下去，满足地伸出舌头舔舐嘴角的碎屑。随后，又伸了个懒腰，四仰八叉地躺下。
“假日，就该懒洋洋的度过啊。”】
Desc.LocalizedString:
【“Would you like another taiyaki? Or a sweet shark?”
Sitting on a floor mat, Fuchsia extends her hands to me, offering a piece of taiyaki in one and a sweet shark in the other - a dilemma of sweetness.
Although it is really tempting, I have already had too many sweet snacks today. I swallow as I firmly refuse Fuchsia's offer.
“Suit yourself.” Fuchsia shrugs before taking a huge bite, licking the crumbs from the corner of her mouth. Then, she stretches lazily and sprawls on the floor.
“This is how you should spend your holiday.”】
